claim_text: Among 93 age-matched untreated NF1 patients in the NCI natural-history study, 73 (78%) had a plexiform neurofibroma volume increase of at least 20% over 3.2 years, with 15% progression-free at 3 years (median 1.3 years), and none had shrinkage of more than 20%.
notes: Full text (PMC7305659). Single-arm phase 2 (n=50, stratum 1 only), unblinded central MRI volumetry; capped at 3 because there is no randomized control (RCT/strength 4 criteria not met). Comparator is a non-randomized external natural-history cohort (NCT00924196). | Grounded by Otto via RTX-KG2c PloverDB + SRI Node Normalizer, accessed 2026-11-18. Natural history comparator. rejection_reason: Semantic triple uses Disease (MONDO:0003304) ASSOCIATED_WITH Disease (MONDO:0018975). Edge_constraints define ASSOCIATED_WITH as {from: [Gene, Mutation], to: [Phenotype, Disease]} — Disease as source is not permitted, and Disease→Disease is semantically nonsensical for this claim. The claim describes natural history disease progression rates, not a genotype-phenotype association. No suitable predicate exists. Consider adding a natural history/progression edge type. | rejection_class=structural: schema gap — no natural-history predicate exists.
